code_finding: Exact pinned streaming_generate sets max_new_token26 on BOTH nonfinal/final chunks, then clears TTS state at end_of_turn. generate_chunk discards its latest token at budget exhaustion. A terminal text longer than the allocated one-second speech budget can therefore be under-rendered. Token2wav already flushes its own existing buffer; increasing file tail silence does not generate missing TTS tokens.
